Subject: Private/VPC pricing - follow-up & token volumes

Thanks for the time this morning — good discussion. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned for the pricing follow-up.

Recap of what you shared:
- Workload: real-time inference for fraud detection + enrichment (mostly short prompts, avg ~60 tokens in, ~120 tokens out).
- Initial ramp expectations: pilot month low single-digit millions, month 2–3 ramp to tens of millions, steady state target range ~50M–150M tokens/month.
- Environments: you mentioned dev, staging, prod (3 environments) + one sandbox for data team.

What we need from you to finalize a tight pricing proposal:
1) Confirm monthly token target range (best guess for month 3 and steady state).
2) Budget range for inference + licensing (ballpark $/1M tokens target or total monthly budget).
3) Preferred support tier: Standard (business hours) vs Premium (24/7 + dedicated TAM).

Attached: rdw_private_pricing_v1.pdf (high-level private/VPC pricing summary) and token_volumes_estimate.xlsx (template we filled with the numbers you gave).

High-level licensing note (details to follow if you confirm volumes):
- We offer a term license for Private/VPC (annual) + per-token usage. Alternatives: reserved capacity commit (discounted per-token) or enterprise flat license + higher support.

Proposed next step: 30-min pricing call to finalize licensing structure and target unit economics — are you available Wednesday, Jul 3 at 10:00am PT or Thursday, Jul 4 at 11:00am PT?

Thanks,
Ben Carter

ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Ben — appreciated the write-up and attachments. A few clarifications so we can get a concrete number out of our CFO: 

1) Token volumes: accurate short-term expectation is roughly 50M–150M tokens/month depending on detection sensitivity and throughput. Pilot (month 1) likely ~5–10M, month 3 we expect to be around 60–80M, and long-term target if rollout goes well ~120–150M.

2) Environments: dev/staging/prod (3) + sandbox for analytics — so 4 total. Important: sandbox will not need SLA or heavy dedicated capacity.

3) Support tier: initially Standard would be fine, but we want pricing for Premium (TAM + 24/7) as an option.

4) Licensing model question: do you price Private/VPC as an annual license + per-token, or is there a per-GPU reserved model? Our procurement prefers a clean $/1M token target for budgeting. For procurement and compliance: we need details on SSO + SAML, data residency (we are US-only), and SOC2 evidence.

Could you send a short table with 3 scenarios (pilot, production mid, production high) showing: env count, license fee, support tier, $/1M token, and estimated monthly total? That will help our CFO sign off.

Thanks — Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Infrastructure | PaymentsAI

Thanks Amit — great notes. I put together the 3-scenario table you asked for (attached one-pager in rdw_private_pricing_v1.pdf and the numbers in token_volumes_estimate.xlsx). Summary pulled out below for quick review: 

Key assumptions: avg cost is influenced by model inference compute, batching, and KV cache hit rate. These examples assume typical batching for short prompts and no heavy retrieval at start.

Scenario A — Pilot
- Volumes: 5–10M tokens/month
- Environments: 3 (dev/staging/prod) + sandbox (no SLA)
- Licensing: Annual term license $25,000 + Standard support
- Unit price: $1,200 per 1M tokens (metered)
- Est. monthly total (10M): $12,500 (tokens) + pro-rated license = ~$14,600

Scenario B — Production Mid
- Volumes: 50–80M tokens/month
- Environments: 3 (prod scaled with autoscale)
- Licensing: Annual term license $50,000 + option for Reserved commit
- Unit price (term license + metered): $800 per 1M tokens
- Est. monthly total (65M): $52,000 (tokens) + license pro-rate = ~$56,200

Scenario C — Production High (enterprise)
- Volumes: 120–150M tokens/month
- Environments: 3 prod + 1 sandbox
- Licensing: Enterprise reserved capacity (12-month commit) + Premium support
- Unit price (reserved/commit): $650 per 1M tokens
- Est. monthly total (130M): $84,500 (tokens) + license pro-rate/internal fees = ~$90k

Support tier explanation:
- Standard: business hours email + standard SLAs
- Premium: 24/7 monitoring, TAM, quarterly business reviews, faster SLA (adds $20k–$40k/year depending on scope)

Licensing models we can offer:
1) Annual term license + per-token metering (default for Private/VPC).
2) Reserved commit (discounted $/1M for 12mo commit).
3) Enterprise flat license (higher upfront, includes broader rights and optional on-prem install) — typically negotiated.

Compliance/controls: we will include SOC2 report, SAML/SSO integration guide, and our data residency commitments for US-only infra in the final packet.

Next steps: 
- Confirm which scenario you want a formal quote for (we can do scenario B as default).
- Pricing call: I can do Thu, Jul 2 at 11:00am PT (30 mins). Does that work?

Ben
